title: World Capitals
sub: Quick recall trivia. Watch for the common traps.

cards.q: What is the capital of Australia?
cards.note: Not Sydney or Melbourne — a very common mistake.

cards.q: What is the capital of Turkey?
cards.note: Istanbul is the largest city, but not the capital.

cards.q: What is the capital of Canada?
cards.note: Not Toronto, the most populous city.
